_comment: Decision rights for the accounting agent. Edit these numbers, not the code.
auto_authorise_max_sgd — mapped vendor + high confidence at or below this posts
straight to Xero as AUTHORISED. Raise it as the digest shows clean weeks.
draft_max_sgd — above the auto limit, at or below this: posted as a Xero DRAFT.
Work done, ledger untouched, deletable. Review these in Xero, not in a sheet.
auto_map_max_sgd — an unmapped vendor this small isn't worth a question; the
agent posts on its suggested account and logs it. 0 disables.
Anything above draft_max_sgd, or any unmapped vendor above auto_map_max_sgd,
Start conservative. Every threshold you raise removes a class of interruption;
raise them from evidence in the Run Log, not from impatience.
